name: self_heal_fixer_provider_deepseek_20261108
comment: ANCHOR: SELF_HEAL_FIXER_PROVIDER_DEEPSEEK_20261108 — the self-heal fixer runs its coding model on DeepSeek
(operator 2026-11-08, LQ-20261107-1258), never on the operator's Anthropic subscription. The shipped
config/self_heal_fixer.json must name a complete claude.provider (name deepseek, the repo launcher, a key_file
PATH only, the DeepSeek host in egress_allow, auth_mode none so no OAuth credential is bound), and the cycle
must REFUSE -- dry run included -- when that block is incomplete or, for --apply, when the key file is not
readable on this host. It never falls back to Anthropic silently. Synthetic fixtures only; no key is read.
